summary: Frontend-only verification of (1) Google auth removal from Login/Register/AuthCallback route and (2) new LiveDashboardDemo replacing screenshot-based Interactive Demo. 69/69 Playwright assertions passed. Login & Register pages no longer expose google-login-btn / google-register-btn testids, no 'Continue with Google' text, no 'or sign in with email' divider, and no Google brand SVG color paths (4285F4/34A853/FBBC05/EA4335). Email/password login still works (drip.tester@example.com -> /api/auth/login 200 -> redirected to /dashboard). Email/password registration still posts to /api/auth/register (201). Visiting / with #session_id=fake_xyz123 renders LandingPage (AuthCallback removed). LiveDashboardDemo renders with all 6 tabs (dashboard/campaign/drip/accounts/warmup/usage), each panel shows expected sample data: Dashboard KPIs (Campaigns Sent 12, Contacts 4,235/10,000, 18 accounts, Warmup 9), all 4 campaigns, all 5 sample emails, all 3 drip sequences. Clicking any action button in a panel fires sonner toast 'This is a preview. Start your free trial to use RouteMail.' Captured ZERO requests to /api/* during a 5s click sequence across tabs and 6+ buttons inside panels. Regression testids (hero-headline, hero-subhead, pricing-card-starter, pricing-card-growth, custom-plan-card, faq-accordion, footer-support-email) all present; custom-plan-price renders ($199 default). Mobile @ 390x844: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=clientWidth=390), live-dashboard-demo remains visible.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js still has a stale comment 'Skip if user passed from AuthCallback' on line 67 inside ProtectedRoute. AuthCallback is fully removed but the comment is misleading; consider rewording to 'Skip if user state was passed via navigate(state)'.

Recharts emits 6 console warnings ('width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0') on the dashboard page after login. Not part of this iteration's scope, but worth a follow-up: add minWidth/minHeight or set aspect on the ResponsiveContainer.

LandingPage.jsx remains large (>1000 lines). Now that the screenshot-based InteractiveDemo block has been replaced with <LiveDashboardDemo />, this is a good opportunity to also extract Header/Footer/Pricing/FAQ into separate files.
